decision_rule.vi: Chỉ đổi cấu trúc thực hiện sau khi lập ánh xạ state nguồn–đích và chuỗi observable tương đương.
decision_rule.en: Change execution structure only after mapping source and target states and their equivalent observable sequence.

cases.description: replace call frames with loop state while retaining output and return order
choose a smaller argument and combine the returned value
preserve intermediate output timing as well as the final result

variants.invariant: After each target transition, its mapped state and observable prefix equal those of the corresponding source transition.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Sau mỗi chuyển tiếp đích, state ánh xạ và prefix observable phải bằng chuyển tiếp nguồn tương ứng.
invariant_bilingual.en: After each target transition, its mapped state and observable prefix equal those of the corresponding source transition.

decision_rule.vi: Chọn representation trước; sau đó ghi riêng null child, empty root và next-free/count theo đúng hợp đồng nguồn.
decision_rule.en: Choose the representation first; then record null child, empty root and next-free/count separately from the source contract.

cases.description: all node rows use the required null sentinel; root/free match source
independent Node objects plus null root/count contract
preserve the supplied first/root Node parameter, including the p35 caveat

variants.invariant: Every live root/child reference is null or names a valid node, and allocation state identifies exactly the unused region without inventing a stack-top meaning.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Mọi root/child reference hoặc là null hoặc trỏ node hợp lệ; allocation state mô tả đúng vùng chưa dùng và không mang nghĩa stack-top.
invariant_bilingual.en: Every live root/child reference is null or names a valid node, and allocation state identifies exactly the unused region without inventing a stack-top meaning.

decision_rule.vi: Chốt duplicate branch trước; chỉ allocate/attach sau khi capacity và vị trí child trống đã được xác nhận.
decision_rule.en: Fix the duplicate branch first; allocate and attach only after capacity and an empty child position are confirmed.

cases.description: follow comparisons until one null child
apply exact equal-key policy or preserve state on full failure

variants.invariant: The reachable structure is a valid source-ordered BST, every pre-existing link is preserved, and allocation state advances only for one attached node.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Cấu trúc reachable vẫn là BST đúng ordering nguồn; link cũ được giữ và allocation chỉ tiến khi một node được gắn.
invariant_bilingual.en: The reachable structure is a valid source-ordered BST, every pre-existing link is preserved, and allocation state advances only for one attached node.

decision_rule.vi: Mỗi comparison chỉ chọn một child pointer; null trả missing, equality trả đúng found contract.
decision_rule.en: Each comparison selects one child pointer; null returns missing and equality returns the exact found contract.

cases.description: equality terminates without following a child
one comparison-selected path and full return propagation
null/bounds base case returns the source missing value

variants.invariant: If the target exists, it remains in the subtree named by current; every discarded subtree is excluded by the BST comparison rule.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Nếu target tồn tại, nó vẫn nằm trong subtree current; mỗi subtree bị bỏ đã được loại bởi quy tắc so sánh BST.
invariant_bilingual.en: If the target exists, it remains in the subtree named by current; every discarded subtree is excluded by the BST comparison rule.

decision_rule.vi: Viết traversal thành chuỗi ba token L/N/R trước; đặt visit event đúng vị trí rồi mới mở rộng recursive calls.
decision_rule.en: Write the traversal as a three-token L/N/R sequence first; place the visit event, then expand recursive calls.

cases.description: left-right-current with current emitted after both returns
null contributes no visit; a leaf contributes exactly one visit

variants.invariant: Completed visit events equal the requested traversal of completed subtrees, and no null child or node is visited twice.

invariant_bilingual.vi: Các visit đã hoàn tất đúng traversal của subtree tương ứng; null không được visit và mỗi node chỉ được visit một lần.
invariant_bilingual.en: Completed visit events equal the requested traversal of completed subtrees, and no null child or node is visited twice.
